sentences.en: But I have to take night shifts twice a week.
sentences.zh: 但我每周要上两次夜班。

sentences.en: Naomi shifted her bag from one hand to the other.
sentences.zh: 娜奥米把包从一只手换到了另一只手。

sentences.en: When you get on the highway, shift into fifth gear.
sentences.zh: 上了高速公路后，换到五档。
